sql:
SELECT
  t2.share
FROM dim_skill AS t1
INNER JOIN mart_skill_demand AS t2
  ON t1.skill = t2.skill
WHERE
  t1.skill = 'SQL'
  AND t2.family = 'data_analyst'
  AND t2.scope = 'all'
